reconcile.note: Gill notes Genesis 8:14 uses a different Hebrew word for dry than 8:13, marking a later, more complete stage of drying rather than a second date for the same event.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible lists Genesis 8:13 and 8:14 as two conflicting dates for the earth's drying after the flood.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells, The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (2013).

sides.snippet: the waters were dried up from off the earth…He saw that the surface of the ground was dried.
sides.verseText: It happened in the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from off the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ark, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dried.

sides.snippet: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.
sides.verseText: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.
